strategy: Check acceptance, quote relevant evidence, explain coverage of every required claim, then choose the verdict. Distinguish a proposed assessment from completed measurements when the criterion permits a plan.
labelProvenance: Synthetic AI-authored answers, not independently human-reviewed production responses. The fresh blind set was authored by a separate AI agent using only the five policy contracts, without the judge prompt, prior labels or results. The tuning agent did not inspect the fresh answers before freezing the prompt.

reportedCost.meaning: Sum of runtime-reported list-price usage estimates, not an additional subscription charge.

limitations: This summary is not a calibration artifact accepted by the engine; full assessments remain in the local ignored archive.
Each set ran once with the same frozen prompt and configuration, without normalization, retries or label edits.
The 80 regression examples had already informed tuning and model selection; only the additional 40 were fresh blind answers.
All labels are synthetic and AI-authored; perfect agreement here is not independently human-reviewed production accuracy or a population error-rate guarantee.
The 80-answer Haiku run cost about 23 times less than the earlier Opus run, but their prompts differed; this is not a controlled same-prompt cost benchmark.
Scoring requires the full passing artifact and exact matching runtime, model, settings, prompt and policy hashes; earlier prompt artifacts are incompatible.
Only five toolkit policies were measured. The other four toolkit policies and all 116 Profisee policies remain advisory. No model defaults changed.
